title: ze_chip_n_dale
description:
⚠️ Requires server plugins: Lua Unlocker & CS2FIX 

 🐿️ FC Chip 'n Dale Adventure V1.0 
 
 Inspired by the classic NES game *Chip 'n Dale: Rescue Rangers*. 
 Made during half a month of after-work free time — a true nostalgic side project! 
 Some features require the Lua Unlocker and CS2FIX plugins. 
 Include a extra Multi-BOSS Mode. Lua Needed. 40% votes to activate it.
 This is a light-hearted, score-farming casual map. 
 Your likes and support on the Workshop keep me motivated — if you enjoy it, please smash that 👍 button! 
 

 
 🧩 New Features 
Multi-BOSS Mode has been added!（2025-10-28）
Players can now vote (requires LUA plugin) to activate Multi-BOSS Mode once 40% of total players agree.
 
 Starts at 2x multiplier and can increase up to 4x as humans win more rounds.
 If humans lose, the multiplier resets to the last winning level.
 
When the multiplier reaches 3x or higher, the BOSS enters Survival Mode:
 
 The BOSS becomes invincible.
 Must survive for 90 seconds to win.
 
This update adds more challenge and tension to every match — good luck surviving!

 

 ✨ Artifact List 

 
 
 Name 
 Description 
 
 
 Infinite Ammo 
 Area effect ability. Press on the button above to activate. Lasts 15s, cooldown 45s. 
 
 
 Mr. Vampire Toy 
 A dark Hammer study... a secret of crashes... 
 
 
 Caodong Toy 
 "You said you don’t want to stay here..." (A little Easter egg reference 😉) 
 
 

 

 

 📝 Plugin Download 
 
 This map requires the following server plugins:
 
 Lua Unlocker 
 CS2FIX
 
 Please search and download them before playing, otherwise some features will not function correctly.
 

 📌 Changelog 
 v1.0 
 
 Survival mode time reduced from 120 seconds to 90 seconds
 Vote function can only toggle Multi-Multiplier Mode once per round, preventing repeated on/off switching
 Added admin control room with one-click enable/disable for Multi-Multiplier Mode
 
 a1.3 
 
 Added an anti-fly board above the first teleport point, automatically removed when player count exceeds 50
 Added invisible walls on the field walls inside the grass area to prevent flying shortcuts
 Added Multi-BOSS Mode (requires LUA), can be enabled by oil barrel voting
 Multi-BOSS Mode starts at 2×, up to 4×. Increases with human victories, decreases with defeats
 
 a1.2 
 
 NPCs now randomly appear as either Chip or Dale 
 Ammo artifact cooldown reduced from 60s → 45s 
 Ammo artifact now has added visual and sound effects 
 After the Boss is defeated, no more defense phase is required — just try your best to survive! 
 Boss no longer deals damage to players, instead it directly teleports them to the zombie cage 
 Boss will always retain at least 40% HP when damaged by grenades 
 Boss room door will not open early, only after pushing the apple completely 
 Added a music easter egg that replaces the second round BGM 
 Adjusted some sound volumes 
 Added a map loading screen image 
 Cleaned up unused assets 
 

 a1.1 
 
 Squirrel crate-throwing interval reduced from 5s → 3s (faster pacing) 
 Squirrel movement speed increased from 100 → 200 (faster pacing) 
 Robot Dog damage 125 → now teleports target into the zombie cage 
 Boss damage: with armor 25 → 50, without armor 50 → 100 
 Boss grenade damage reduced from 200 → 100 
 Boss can only be damaged by grenades during awakening (first 5s before moving) 
 Fixed nuclear stuck issue 
 Fixed infinite ammo sometimes not working properly 
 Removed the last defense point 
 Coin healing increased from 5 → 10 
 

 a1.0 
 
 First release upload!
